_comment: Vesilabra (games/vesilabra): written by tools/vesilabra/texts.py; the Finnish clips are in voice/fi.json.

clips.vl_intro_sb: Sandbox. Hold your finger on the screen and water pours there. Below you can choose sand, a wall or a water wheel.
clips.vl_intro_1: The water can't reach the tank because the red valve is closed. Tap the valve.
clips.vl_flow: Good! Now the water flows down. Wait until it reaches the line.
clips.vl_intro_2: The pipes are not connected. Tap a pipe to turn it. Make a way for the water to the tank.
clips.vl_pipes_ok: Good, the pipes are connected! The water goes to the tank.
clips.vl_intro_3: This is a water wheel. When water falls on its right side, it turns clockwise and lifts the gate. Turn the pipe.
clips.vl_wrong_way: The wheel turns the wrong way because the water falls on its left side. Turn the pipe.
clips.vl_right_way: Good! The wheel turns the right way and the gate goes up.
clips.vl_gate: The gate is open! The water pours into the tank.
clips.vl_intro_4: Two vessels are joined by a pipe. First open the valve at the bottom.
clips.vl_same: Look: the water rises to the same height in both vessels.
clips.vl_close_tap: The water is almost at the line. Close the tap!
clips.vl_too_much: Too much water! Open the valve under the left vessel and let some water out.
clips.vl_intro_5: Now the vessels need different heights. First fill both to the lower line.
clips.vl_close_mid: Close the middle valve so the water in the right vessel stops rising.
clips.vl_fill_left: Now fill the left vessel to the upper line.
clips.vl_intro_6: The water escapes into the pit. Hold your finger over the pit and sand pours into it.
clips.vl_more_sand: Add sand until the pit is full.
clips.vl_sand_ok: Good! The wet sand holds the water, and it reaches the tank.
clips.vl_no_sand: The sand ran out. Start again.
clips.vl_learn_1: Water flows down because gravity pulls it.
clips.vl_learn_2: Water only follows the pipes when they are connected.
clips.vl_learn_3: Flowing water does work: it turns a water wheel.
clips.vl_learn_4: In connected vessels the water stands at the same height.
clips.vl_learn_5: A closed valve breaks the connection, and the levels can differ.
clips.vl_learn_6: Wet sand holds water back, but a sieve lets water through.
